run_spider_dataset_generation: run the main function to generate k-shot Spider dataset splits with multiple random seeds
create_spider_dataset_instance: create a Spider dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace Spider text-to-SQL dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace Spider dataset split to a list of question and SQL query tuples
load_spider_dataset: load the Spider dataset from HuggingFace datasets library using the load_dataset method
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, development, and test splits from the Spider dataset with a given seed
